description: Defines the BufferQueue class for managing buffer slots, including nested ProxyConsumerListener class, constants, and createBufferQueue function; part of Android graphics buffer management.

classes.name: BufferQueue
classes.description: Manages a pool of graphics buffer slots, handles buffer creation, and maintains consumer/producer interactions.

classes.name: BufferQueue::ProxyConsumerListener
classes.description: Implements a weak-reference forwarding consumer listener to avoid circular dependencies.

methods.name: createBufferQueue
methods.description: Creates and outputs a buffer producer and consumer pair.

methods.name: ProxyConsumerListener::addAndGetFrameTimestamps
methods.description: Adds and retrieves frame timestamp information.
